transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’ve just been having a hard time getting myself to do things. It’s not like I’m trying to be lazy or anything, I just… mostly sit in my room. I’ve kind of been wearing the same clothes a lot, and I don’t really do the things I used to, like knitting or journaling or going on walks.

My mom asks me what’s wrong, and I don’t really know what to say. Sometimes I barely have the energy to answer her. I’m sorry, I don’t know if that explains it right.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy most of the time, almost every day?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t know if I’d call it “down” all the time, exactly, but I just don’t really… do anything anymore. I mostly sit in my room, and I’ve been wearing the same clothes more than I probably should.

I used to knit and journal and go for walks, and now I just can’t make myself start. When my mom asks me what’s wrong, I barely have the energy to answer her. I’m sorry if that sounds bad… but yes, it’s been happening a lot.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or blamed yourself for things more than usual?

Um… I don’t know. Not really, I guess? I mean, I get frustrated with myself for not doing more, but I don’t sit there thinking I’m a terrible person or anything. At least… I don’t think so.

Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you been feeling more tired than usual, or like you don’t have any energy?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it’s like I don’t have the energy to start anything.

Mostly I just stay in my room, and I’ll realize I’ve been in the same clothes again. I used to knit, or write in my journal, or go for walks, and now even those feel like… too much. And when my mom asks me what’s wrong, sometimes I can barely answer her.

I’m sorry, is that what you mean by tired?
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to focus or make decisions lately?

Um… I’m not sure. I mean, I guess I zone out sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s more than normal.

Decisions… maybe I put things off, but I haven’t really noticed a big change, I don’t think. Sorry, I’m not sure if that answers it right.
Have you found that activities you used to enjoy, like knitting or walking, don’t give you the same pleasure anymore?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to sound dramatic, because it’s not like I hate those things now or anything. I just… don’t really do them.

Like knitting or journaling, or even going for a walk, they used to feel nice, and now it’s more like I can’t make myself start. I mostly just sit in my room, sometimes still in the same clothes, and then my mom asks what’s wrong and I barely have the energy to answer her.

So… yeah, I guess they don’t really feel the same anymore. Is that what you mean?
Would you say you’ve been feeling down or depressed most days, even if it’s not extremely intense?

I… I don’t know if I’d call it depressed. Maybe that sounds too strong.

I’m not exactly happy, but it’s more like I feel kind of flat or heavy a lot of the time. Some days are okay, I guess. I don’t want to exaggerate it. But… yeah, I guess most days I don’t feel very good.

Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Would you say that most days you feel a depressed mood, even if it's not very strong?

I think… maybe? I’m sorry, I know you asked that already. I guess most days I feel kind of low, but I don’t know if I’d call it a “depressed mood” exactly. It’s not always really strong or anything.

It’s more like I’m just not feeling like myself, kind of weighed down. Does that count?
Would you say that most days you feel a depressed mood, even if it's not very strong?

I’m… not totally sure how to answer it differently. I don’t want to say yes too strongly if that’s not right.

Most days I do feel kind of low or dull, I guess. Not like crying all day or anything, just… not good. If that counts as depressed mood, then maybe yes.
Have you had a period of time where you felt this way nearly every day for at least two weeks in a row?

I’m not completely sure… I don’t really keep track of days very well.

It feels like it’s been around a lot, but saying “nearly every day for two weeks” sounds so specific. I don’t want to answer wrong. Maybe there have been stretches like that, but I’m not sure enough to say yes confidently.
Have you had a time when you felt this way most days, almost every day, for a couple of weeks or more?

I… I’m sorry, I’m still not sure. I don’t want to say yes if I’m just remembering it wrong.

It has felt like that a lot, like most days I’m kind of down, but when you say almost every day for a couple weeks or more, I don’t know if I can be certain. Maybe, but I’m not sure.
Can you think of a specific time in the past few months when you felt this way—like you were kind of down or dull most days—for at least two weeks straight, without much of a break?

I can’t really think of a specific stretch like that, not clearly. I mean, I’ve had days where I feel kind of dull or low, but putting it into “two weeks straight without much of a break” is hard for me to say.

I don’t want to overstate it. Maybe it happened, but I’m not sure enough to point to a time and say yes.
Can you think of a time when you felt down, low, or dull most days, even if not extremely strong, for a period of two weeks or more, where it felt like it was happening more days than not?

I’m trying to think of it that way… more days than not. I guess I still can’t say for sure.

It’s been kind of on and off in my memory, like I know I’ve felt low or dull sometimes, but I don’t really have a clear period I can point to and say, “yes, that was two weeks or more.” I don’t want to give you the wrong answer just to be helpful.

Can you say whether there have been several weeks in total over the past few months when you felt low or dull most days—even if not extremely strong—so that it added up to a significant amount of time feeling that way?

I think… maybe it adds up some, but I don’t know if I can say “several weeks” confidently. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is.

There have been low or dull days, yeah, but when I try to count them it gets blurry. I’m sorry, is it okay if I just say I’m not really sure?
Over the past two years, would you say you’ve had days with low or dull mood more often than not, even if not every single day?

Over the past two years… I don’t think I can say “more often than not,” honestly. I’ve had low or dull days, but I haven’t really kept track like that, and it’s hard for me to tell looking back.

I don’t want to answer wrong. I’d say I’ve noticed it sometimes, but I’m not sure it was most days.
Over the past two years, have you had times when you felt low or dull on most days, even if not every day, for several weeks or more at a time?

I’m still not totally sure. I don’t really remember a stretch where I could say it was most days for several weeks.

There were times I felt kind of flat or low, but I don’t want to overstate it. Maybe it happened here and there, but I can’t confidently say yes to “most days for several weeks.” Is that okay to say?
Over the past two years, have you had a depressed mood — even if not very strong — for a significant part of the day, most days?

I don’t think so… not most days, at least not that I can say for sure. I have had times where I felt kind of dull or down for part of the day, but when you say “significant part of the day, most days,” I’m not really sure that fits.

I’m sorry, I don’t want to be difficult. I just don’t want to say yes if I can’t really back it up.
Over the past two years, have you had days where you felt depressed — even a little — for a big part of the day, not just for a short while?

I mean… I’ve had days like that sometimes, where I felt down for longer than just a few minutes. But I don’t know if it was happening a lot, or enough to say it was a pattern.

I guess I’d say yes, there were some days, but I’m not sure how often. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Over the past two years, have you had many days where you felt down or depressed for a big part of the day, even if it wasn’t very strong?

I’m not sure I’d say many days. There were some days where I felt kind of down for a while, yeah, but I don’t really know if it was a lot or most days.

I don’t want to say no if I’m missing something, but I also don’t want to make it sound bigger than it was. Maybe just… sometimes, not clearly many? Does that answer it okay?
